audit_execution.note: Later C1 Router/Activity executions and the ongoing lint are separate evidence and are not attributed to this audit.

conclusion.central_full_node_scope: Only direct *.test.mjs entries of .github/continuum and scripts; no recursive tools/ discovery.
conclusion.additional_tools_tests: Separate development-tool/research acceptance unless explicitly included by a particular required runner/contract. Existing tests under the two canonical roots remain required even when they concern isolation.

reported_external_tools_failures.attribution: Parent report; not an executed result of this audit

conclusion.capability_boundary: Central app QA cannot prove or repair missing real host isolation, autonomous coding capability, genuine model inference or device behavior.
conclusion.no_waiver: No FAIL is converted to PASS/SKIP; no isolation substitute or permission bypass is authorized.

evidence_requirements: Exact source SHA/profile and fresh receipt
mandatory_node.overlap: Special, critical and full-node overlap; counts must not be summed as independent coverage.

mandatory_android.scope: Full unit suite plus app/src/uiTest/java; no test-class filter.
ui_effect: Adds src/uiTest/java to test source set
evidence_requirements: Fresh regular non-symlink JUnit files from this run
Required suites present and actually executed
mandatory_android.minimum_scope_note: 11+5 are completeness checks, not permission to replace the full suite with selected classes.
mandatory_android.other_skips: The existing validator permits reported skips in non-required classes; these are not capability PASS and cannot retroactively reclassify FAIL.

lint.allowed_claim: Configured NewApi lint, not all Android lint rules.

checks: All preceding gates green for final QA success
apksigner verify must not confirm a signed artifact
No signing file/password/base64 material in QA
mandatory_unsigned_apk.ordering_note: The existing script accumulates assembly diagnostics even after an earlier failed gate, then rejects final QA success if any gate failed.

environment_contract.actions: No GitHub Actions for acceptance; real Render or demonstrably working local gates.
environment_contract.recorded_toolchain: Existing script pins Temurin 17.0.20.1+1, Gradle 8.11.1, SDK36 and build-tools35.0.0.
environment_contract.render_wrapper: Pinned real service/host/approved SHA and integration/continuum-all-systems-apk-qa-20261102 (or trusted detached reattachment); do not fake Render variables or branch identity for C1 local execution.
environment_contract.local_equivalence: AGENTS permits local execution with actual source identity, identical gate scopes and evidence validation.
